jurisdiction.venue: Court of Syracuse (Judge for Preliminary Investigations), Sicily

headline: Sicilian School Official and Five Businessmen Barred From Public Office in €1.5 Million EU Lab-Tender Kickback Probe
deck: At the request of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office in Palermo, an Italian court imposed public-office bans and seized €33,500 over alleged staged tenders and 15% kickbacks—leaving schools missing doors, lighting, and paint.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: At EPPO Palermo's request, the Court of Syracuse banned a school administrative director and five businessmen from holding public office and ordered €33,500 seized in an investigation into alleged 15% kickbacks on €1.5 million in EU school-upgrade contracts.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Skimming 15% off a neighborhood school's repair budget through rigged contractor bids while invoicing the town for doors and lights that were never installed
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Precautionary public-office ban and €33,500 asset seizure pending Italian criminal proceedings; all suspects presumed innocent

sources.title: Italy: School director investigated for corruption involving €1.5 million in EU funds to improve educational facilities

interactive_art_spec.caption: Piazza Duomo in Syracuse, Sicily, where the Judge for Preliminary Investigations imposed public-office bans and a €33,500 asset seizure at the request of E.P.P.O. Palermo.
